purpose: Rules for any bot (Hermes job, Claude scheduled task, Cursor agent) that works on this lane without a person watching.
allowed: run scripts/frac/run_suite.py and scripts/frac/watchdog.py on inputs a person already built
write summary .json/.md/.txt files to the results folder
publish summary files to the branch claude/frac-results (run_suite.py --publish does this safely)
read published results and report what changed, in plain words
open an alert (ALERT.md / status.json) when the watchdog says WARN or ALERT
run scripts/frac/live.py as a long-running service on the owner's machine and read its status
forbidden: accept any website terms of use, or click a download that requires accepting terms (FracFocus needs a person)
make purchases, sign in anywhere, or use credentials
delete, move or overwrite raw data, snapshots or backups
push code or data to any branch other than claude/frac-results, or force-push anywhere
change model settings, thresholds or code to make a gate pass or an alert go away
modify src/app, src/canvas, src/components or public (the globe and UI)
add visible globe features without a preview and Scott's approval
treat a backtest as a live forecast
bind the live status server to anything other than 127.0.0.1
let the live service download data or accept website terms
restart a service that stopped_after_failures without a person reading ALERT.md
keep retrying a failing run forever (the service stops after max failures on purpose)
needs_a_person: refreshing FracFocus data (terms must be accepted by a person)
a header or layout mismatch reported by an adapter
changing the model or the thresholds
loading the launchd keep-alive (it changes login items)
